t: Titan TTB1353VAC 40Ltr wet and dry vacuum cleaner delivers powerful 1400W suction to clear dust, debris, sludge and water. Designed for building sites and workshops, making light work of heavy-duty, wet or dry trade clean-ups. The large 40Ltr drum capacity minimises emptying frequency, whilst an integrated blower function easily clears debris from tight corners. A power take-off socket allows synchronised dust extraction when working with power tools. Also equipped with hose and cable collection for tidy working, and easy-roll castors and wheels to provide smooth mobility across rough floors. Can be used with or without dust bags. Supplied with filter bag, foam sleeve, cartridge filter, floor nozzle, crevice tool, round brush and plastic wands.
b: Can be Used With or Without Dust Bags
